acceptance_effect: No criterion or percentage is earned. The complete two-worker frozen gate must prove this order and its abort/replacement failures.
corrected_order: The assigned worker validates the frozen absolute working directory and local deployment availability before claim without importing user code.
The worker creates the durable CLAIMED grant but keeps the capability and event private key out of the child.

The same blocked child imports and validates entrypoint, task key/version/artifact, role, context/input names, policy, timeout, tags, options and its own bounded parameters with no Subtask context or platform credential, and retains the validated Task object.
Only after READY does the worker register that exact PID/start ticks and deliver the private bootstrap.
The child compares the bootstrap with the retained object and waits for global ACTIVE/GO before constructing scoped authority or invoking the task body; it does not re-import.
Preflight failure kills and reaps the CLAIMED/unregistered child and requires the trusted unstarted stop receipt before slot release.
security_boundary: Module import is trusted application initialization, not hostile-code sandboxing. It has no Prefect mutation authority; arbitrary external import side effects remain outside this bounded profile.

supersedes_phrase.old_summary: The worker validates the imported artifact/code witness before claim.
supersedes_phrase.reason: A claim is the durable anchor for cleanup of a cap-free preflight process. Importing before claim would make an untracked local process contradict the unclaimed-means-no-child abort invariant.
